content: Mobile PDF/reading UX best practices: pinch-to-zoom must be smooth without conflicting with page-flip gestures; realistic page-turn animation (optionally with subtle sound) creates immersive book-like feel; night/dark mode (dedicated reading theme, not simple color-invert) reduces eye strain and battery use; custom viewer chrome should match app branding rather than mimic generic desktop PDF toolbars; controls (zoom/nav) must meet touch-target accessibility minimums; text reflow is a plus for plain documents but not applicable when preserving original calligraphic page layout is required.
